name: EssayTone
what: AI text humanizer built by ex-Stanford researchers that transforms AI-generated content into natural, scholarly writing while bypassing AI detection tools.
evidence: Website confirmed through search (essaytone.com has anti-bot protection). Product by ex-Stanford researchers with 70+ countries user base, pricing $9.99-$59.99/month, trusted by students and researchers for essay writing.

name: Rezi
what: AI-powered resume builder that optimizes CVs for ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems) compatibility to improve job application success.
evidence: Active service with 4.5M+ total users, multiple pricing tiers (Free, Pro $29/month, Lifetime $149), recent product launches (Chrome Extension, AI Resume Agent), SOC 2 certified.

name: Hejour
what: A macOS and iOS notebook app based on daily pages where notes can reference each other, with iCloud sync.
evidence: Active daily updates, recent version 2.8, available on App Store and GitHub, 1000+ daily active users, 10000+ downloads, active developer (Enes Genç) maintaining the project, Discord community.

name: uncovr
what: Austrian news monitoring and aggregation platform for media professionals and journalists to access original sources and track news.
evidence: Active service by WUNDERWERK ONLINE GmbH (Vienna), functional features (newsletter, newsroom, indexation services), actively accepting new user registrations.

name: Cudekai
what: Suite of AI tools that humanizes AI-generated text, detects AI content, and provides plagiarism checking for academic and professional writing.
evidence: Active web platform with text humanizer, AI detector, and plagiarism detection integrated into single interface.

name: Macaw
what: Platform for intelligent digital receipts (pré-lancement/early access) transforming static receipts into customer engagement and monetization tools for retailers.
evidence: Site at macaw.app shows early access signup with 'Get notified when we launch' message. Original URL macaw-hq.com has dead DNS. Product not yet publicly available but team actively collecting pre-launch registrations (contact joseph@macaw.app).

name: Grokipedia
what: AI-powered encyclopedia by xAI (Elon Musk's company) launched October 2025 as alternative to Wikipedia, currently at 5.6M articles with Grok 3 model.
evidence: Confirmed through search results. Active service with 5.6M articles as of early 2026, powered by Grok 3 model with X DataStream API integration (500M+ daily posts). Currently in public v0.1 with rapid expansion nearing Wikipedia's English corpus size.

name: Craft
what: Cross-platform note-taking and document management app combining notes, task management, and content publishing in unified interface.
evidence: Active development with recent App Store awards (2024), Apple Design Awards recipient, MCP and Claude Code integrations in progress, 200+ builders in community, no discontinuation signals.

name: Octarine
what: Private, local Markdown note-taking application designed for focused writing and personal knowledge management.
evidence: Active service with recent revision (2026-08-17), public documentation and RSS feed available, iOS beta in development, regular feature updates.

name: Wispr Flow
what: Real-time voice-to-text AI application that transcribes speech and automatically cleans up output (removes filler words, adds punctuation) across all apps.
evidence: Active product with recent funding announcement (Wispr raises $81M), new product launches (Notetaker), no discontinuation signals detected.

name: Notable (Unknown)
evidence: Domain notable.so showing Namecheap expiration notice: 'Domain registration has expired'. No active service or product accessible.

name: QuillBot
what: AI writing assistant with paraphrasing, grammar checking, summarization, translation and citation generation for writers of all levels.
evidence: Confirmed through search. 35M+ users globally. Paraphraser with 9 preset modes, premium pricing ~$19.95/month, student tier ~$6.25/month. Active development and maintenance in 2026.

name: MyKeep (Abandoned)
what: Abandoned project from early 2000s, purpose unclear.
evidence: Site shows perpetual 'Under Construction' placeholder page with 9/11 memorial content, appears abandoned for 20+ years. No product documentation or active development evidence.

name: Bear
what: Native Markdown note-taking app for macOS, iPhone and iPad by Shiny Frog with iCloud sync, export options and customizable themes.
evidence: Active service with regular updates (Bear 2 recent), free and paid tiers (Bear Pro €2.99/month or €29.99/year), no discontinuation signals, committed to future development.

name: TrendHopper
what: AI-powered blogging and SEO automation platform combining topic ideation, content generation, scheduling and SEO optimization for content creators.
evidence: Confirmed through search results. Unfunded startup founded 2024 by Seth King (Boston). All-in-one platform with Reddit/SERP data integration, automated scheduling, built-in SEO tools. Note: .com redirects to .nl (furniture retailer site), but AI tool is confirmed as real product.

name: Lunatask
what: All-in-one encrypted app combining task management, habit tracking, journaling and note-taking with cross-device sync and mental wellness features.
evidence: Active service with Lunatask 3.0 in development, no discontinuation signals, integrated wellness and well-being tracking features.

name: Outrank
what: SaaS SEO automation platform that generates and publishes optimized articles daily to build domain authority and organic traffic.
evidence: Active service with functional pricing tiers, FAQ section, maintained integrations, active signup calls-to-action, no service discontinuation indicators.

name: Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM)
what: Google's AI research assistant powered by Gemini using RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) for source-grounded document analysis and note-taking.
evidence: Confirmed through search results. Hit 30M+ users and 600000+ organizations before rebranding to Gemini Notebook (July 16, 2026). Features: Audio Overviews (podcast-like summaries), code cloud computer, chart/spreadsheet/slide generation, up to 1M token context window.
